name: Ricardo Silva
bio:
Ricardo's journey to motorsport security began in his hometown of São Paulo, where he grew up around the bustling environment of local karting circuits. He initially volunteered as a marshal, quickly developing an eye for detail and risk assessment. Seeing the potential for a career, he pursued security certifications and shadowed experienced personnel at various racing events.

Ricardo is known for his calm and methodical approach. He believes a proactive stance is crucial, focusing on preventative measures to mitigate potential security breaches. He is still developing his leadership skills, but he is eager to learn and implement best practices. He is particularly interested in integrating modern technologies, like AI-powered surveillance, into existing security protocols.

What sets Ricardo apart is his deep understanding of Brazilian motorsport culture, combined with a genuine desire to ensure the safety and integrity of every event he oversees. He is committed to building a secure environment for all involved.

physical.description: Ricardo is of average height, with a sturdy build from years of physical activity.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations.
Has a habit of double-checking every lock and seal, even when he knows it's secure.
Drinks mate throughout the day, claiming it helps him stay alert.
